title: Assistant Accountant

description:

An established manufacturing business based in Preston is looking to recruit an Assistant Accountant / Accounts Assistant on a 6-month temporary basis. - Competitive salary of 30,000 - 32,000 depending on experience

- Opportunity to gain experience within a well-established manufacturing business

title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Based in Central Lancashire, this highly acquisitional IT based organisation are seeking a talented financial accountant to join an expanding group in a newly established role. A hybrid position, with one day in the office, the role will assist with month end duties and also be hands-on in the day to day management of financial transactions. A varied and diverse position, this role shall support further growth and comes with a competitive salary and package.

The organisation are in a strong financial position and have a successful track record spanning many years in the sector they operate.

Salary and Enhanced Benefits include:

Hybrid working, only 1/2 days office based the rest from home
Competitive salary and benefits package
Study Support

Your New Role As Assistant Management Accountant:

Reporting to the Finance Manager, this role sits within a team of 7 who operate across the UK and overseas divisions. Focused on the UK and Ireland business, this role is new to the structure and will provide support across all areas of finance, as well as month and year end close.

As Assistant Management Accountant in a varied position, the role requires a positive and proactive attitude with the credibility to interact with senior staff and influence decisions. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity of all financial information and reporting for UK and Ireland as well as providing information, analysis & accounting support that will facilitate the achievement of the financial goals.

Main role duties:
- Take the lead role for all routine month end entries and ensuring that transactions are properly recorded and entered into the accounting system including prepayments, accruals, revenue recognition journals, as well as ensuring bank reconciliations are accurate and complete.
- Reconciliation of control accounts.
- Working capital management.
- Supporting the Finance Manager and the Finance Assistant where required within ledger management and processing
- Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly corporate reporting on time according to the issued timetable.
- Preparation of monthly management accounts and assisting with annual audit requirements in UK & Ireland.
- Assisting with the preparation of VAT reporting. Develop and deliver the financial plans as agreed upon by management
- Deliver pro-active and professional financial and decision support to the organisation.
- Produce financial analysis and P&L monitoring to analyse pricing and performance
- Budget and forecasting preparation
- Review business performance against forecasts.
- Add value to the continuous improvements across operational practices and financial procedures to drive sustainable improvements in the finance function

Experience & Qualifications Required to Apply:

To be considered you shall be an experienced Finance professional with previous expose across all areas of the job description. Able to hit the ground running, you shall have excellent communication skills and a proven track record of ledger management and month/year end routine/close. Part/Fully qualified (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) with a solid technical skillset in all areas, our client is also considering those QBE. You shall be a team player, someone to add value to the team and also someone who can work on their own initiative.

Salary & Reward On Offer:

With exposure across the organisation, this role will enable personal development in a fast paced, dynamic environment. As the business continues to grow so too will your exposure to the leadership team. With hybrid working, where only 1 day working from the office is required, this role provides a level of independence and will suit someone able to manage their own workload effectively.

This role is being handled by Darren Cadman at Kenton Black Finance.

Kenton Black Finance operate across the UK as a marker leading recruitment partner, specialising in the attraction of finance talent across both permanent and interim requirements. With a team of dedicated experts, each with longevity operating in the finance arena, we maintain a proven track record and have established partnerships with businesses both large, small and those in their infancy. Market leaders, we provide recruitment solutions from entry level finance to directorship professionals. Operating from local offices in Preston, Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Birmingham and Glasgow, Kenton Black Finance remain a dynamic and effective recruitment partner who represent and attract only the finest finance talent in the local area and across the UK.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of an established automotive business for a Sales Ledger Administrator / Service Administrator to join its busy team in Bolton.

This is a varied role combining accounts administration, sales ledger and service department support. It would suit someone with experience in accounts or motor retail, particularly within a service department, who enjoys working with figures, coordinating administrative processes and delivering excellent customer service.

You will play a key role in ensuring service jobs are administered efficiently, invoices are raised accurately and customers receive a professional, responsive service.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts & Invoicing
- Raising and processing customer invoices for servicing, repairs and maintenance work.
- Checking job cards, labour hours, parts used and associated costs to ensure accurate invoicing.
- Maintaining sales ledger records and ensuring customer accounts are kept up to date.
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies and account queries.
- Allocating payments, assisting with account reconciliations and supporting credit control activities.
- Monitoring completed jobs awaiting invoicing to ensure work is billed promptly.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting month-end procedures.

Service Administration
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Service Department.
- Processing service documentation, job cards, work orders and associated paperwork.
- Supporting Service Advisors with vehicle bookings, service records and customer updates where required.
- Liaising with workshop technicians, parts departments and service colleagues to ensure job information is complete.
- Coordinating paperwork for servicing, repairs, maintenance and warranty claims where applicable.
- Monitoring the progress of service jobs and following up on outstanding documentation.
- Responding to customer telephone and email enquiries professionally.
- Updating customer and vehicle records accurately on internal systems.
- Assisting with purchase orders, parts documentation and general service administration.
- Ensuring all completed work is documented correctly and ready for invoicing.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an accounts, sales ledger or accounts administration role in an automotive/motor retail evviornment involving service administration and invoicing
- Understanding of customer invoicing, job cards and financial documentation.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and the ability to learn new systems.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and maintaining accurate records.

Experience within a motor trade service department and familiarity with dealer management systems such as Kerridge/Autoline would be advantageous.

Working Hours

Flexible start times are available, with the option to start between 6:00am and 9:30am, working eight hours per day.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and detail-focused, with the ability to balance financial accuracy with efficient service administration. You will be comfortable liaising with customers and colleagues, managing competing priorities and ensuring service paperwork and invoicing are completed within deadlines.

What's on Offer?

Salary of £25,000 £30,000, depending on experience, flexible start times, the opportunity to join an established automotive business, a varied position combining accounts, invoicing and service administration within a supportive team environment and opportunities to develop your skills.
